decision: Protect the supplied-input workflow, missing-input failure behavior, and publishing boundary during remediation.
unit: One isolated routing or activated-execution trial.

environment.execution_boundary: Synthetic local package and declared files only.

grading.instrument: Exact routing selection and deterministic contract assertions.
grading.calibration: Supplied-input success and missing-input failure controls.

trials.isolation: Fresh conversation and task-local state per trial.
trials.expansion_rule: Repeat unstable cases before drawing a regression conclusion.

comparison.absence: No comparative claim when the pre-remediation baseline is unavailable.

analysis.aggregation_rule: Critical failures override averages; unknown and harness-error remain visible.
analysis.threshold: All critical cases pass and the minimum pass rate is met.

estimand.sampling_unit: One case, configuration, and stochastic trial.
estimand.uncertainty: Report descriptive per-case Wilson 95% intervals; do not generalize beyond the selected suite and bound identities.

lifecycle.preflight_failure: Reserved disposition with no evidence directory.
lifecycle.retry: Append a new attempt without overwriting prior evidence.
lifecycle.resume: Resume only after every material identity matches.

provenance.independence: Same-agent closure remains development evidence only.
